# laravelforge_server_background_process (Data Source)

Fetches a single background process by ID on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the background process.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the background process runs on.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) The command that the background process is running.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `directory` (String) The directory that the background process is running in.
- `processes` (Number) The number of processes that the background process is running.
- `status` (String) The status of the background process.
- `type` (String) JSON:API resource type.
- `user` (String) The user that the background process is running as.
